newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel Aircraft, Fedex discussing plane deal - paper.
newsitem.headline: Israel Aircraft, Fedex discussing plane deal - paper.

text.p: Israel Aircraft Industries (IAI) is negotiating a deal worth up to $2 billion to build cargo planes for the U.S. courier Federal Express Corp, an Israeli newspaper said on Monday.
The government-owned IAI confirmed the two sides were negotiating a plane deal but refused to disclose details. A Fedex official in Israel declined comment.
"These are preliminary talks. It's too early to discuss details," an IAI spokeswoman said.
The financial daily Globes said IAI would build between 100 and 200 medium-sized planes for $10 million to $12 million each. The planes would be supplied at a pace of 50 per year.
Fedex began its first regularly scheduled flights into and out of Israel last June with a Boeing 727. The company had been operating in Israel since 1990 through a local agent.
